literal: Day jiashen: an edict ordered Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Minister of the Masters of Writing Li Chong and General of the Center Army and Acting Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Zuan to lead one hundred thousand cavalry against the Rouran; they went beyond the frontier more than three thousand li, did not overtake them, and returned.
idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict ordered Li Chong, grand general who conquers on horseback and minister of the Masters of Writing, and Yuan Zuan, general of the center army and acting right vice director of the Masters of Writing, to lead one hundred thousand cavalry against the Rouran; they went beyond the frontier more than three thousand li, failed to overtake them, and returned.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day xinhai, an edict stated: "The most honored is present; in years one is counted among them. Reverence for the hoary-headed is a teaching of former ages.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinhai day, an edict stated: "The most honored is present; in years one is counted among them. Reverence for the hoary-headed is a teaching of former ages.

literal: Hence Fang Shu held office as an elder statesman, and Zhao Chongnian because of his own vigor was retained.
idiomatic: Hence Fang Shu held office as an elder statesman, and Zhao Chongnian because of his own vigor was retained.

literal: Although at seventy one should retire, as the classics make clear, yet when virtue is still robust, one may be allowed to remain bound to office.
idiomatic: Although at seventy one should retire, as the classics make clear, yet when virtue is still robust, one may be allowed to remain bound to office.

literal: Now among the various officials some approach the age for suspension of the carriage and by ritual ought to withdraw.
idiomatic: Now among the various officials some approach the age for suspension of the carriage and by ritual ought to withdraw.

literal: Yet to take away their strength while young and abandon their persons when old—when I think of their long service, I cannot bear it.
idiomatic: Yet to take away their strength while young and abandon their persons when old—when I think of their long service, I cannot bear it.

literal: Some wear white hair at court and are not yet fit for posts outside the capital;
idiomatic: Some wear white hair at court and are not yet fit for posts outside the capital;

literal: some have just completed private reckonings of years and have only now received their assessment grades;
idiomatic: some have just completed private reckonings of years and have only now received their assessment grades;

literal: such persons, though they have reached seventy, may be allowed to govern the people until their regular term ends.
idiomatic: such persons, though they have reached seventy, may be allowed to govern the people until their regular term ends.

literal: Those who have newly left prefectures and counties, or who have just ceased serving as external aides, and who, having already reached seventy, now seek reappointment—the Ministry of Personnel may, according to the edict, not memorialize them.
idiomatic: Those who have newly left prefectures and counties, or who have just ceased serving as external aides, and who, having already reached seventy, now seek reappointment—the Ministry of Personnel may, according to the edict, not memorialize them.

literal: Those of lofty fame and outstanding virtue, elders of mature years, men plainly eminent and known to the age, are not bound by this rule.
idiomatic: Those of lofty fame and outstanding virtue, elders of mature years, men plainly eminent and known to the age, are not bound by this rule.

literal: If talent is not outstanding and one now holds office at court and ought to be dismissed under the edict, he may be given half the salary of his former office for life.
idiomatic: If talent is not outstanding and one now holds office at court and ought to be dismissed under the edict, he may be given half the salary of his former office for life.

literal: Thus old men leaving court will not regret returning to their lanes."
idiomatic: Thus old men leaving court will not regret returning to their lanes."

literal: Eighth month, day jisi, an edict stated: "Madness and folly run riot; they encroach on the northern marches. Though our armies press them from time to time and the bandits shrink back in fear, wherever the savage cruelty passes many are torn from their homes. When I think of this harm, my heart is deeply pained.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi day, an edict stated: "Madness and folly run riot; they encroach on the northern marches. Though our armies press them from time to time and the bandits shrink back in fear, wherever the savage cruelty passes many are torn from their homes. When I think of this harm, my heart is deeply pained.

literal: The Northern Route Mobile Office should be ordered to send envoys on inspection tour; wherever the raiders passed, those starving with no grain to eat should be generously relieved and succored, with every effort to preserve them."
idiomatic: The Northern Route Mobile Office should be ordered to send envoys on inspection tour; wherever the raiders passed, those starving with no grain to eat should be generously relieved and succored, with every effort to preserve them."

literal: Day wuyin, an edict stated: "I, small and dim, unworthily inherit the great succession; relying on the foundation of the ancestors, I rest upon the princes and dukes. Each waking and sleeping I fix my thoughts, seeking to bring peace to the hundred millions.
idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict stated: "I, small and dim, unworthily inherit the great succession; relying on the foundation of the ancestors, I rest upon the princes and dukes. Each waking and sleeping I fix my thoughts, seeking to bring peace to the hundred millions.

literal: Lately rain and drought have been out of season, the stars and their courses err, government is not harmonious, and the spirits show prodigies. Long I search myself in evening vigil; shame fills my breast.
idiomatic: Lately rain and drought have been out of season, the stars and their courses err, government is not harmonious, and the spirits show prodigies. Long I search myself in evening vigil; shame fills my breast.

literal: All hundred offices should be ordered each to be diligent in his duty; all who are widowers, orphans, destitute, ill, wronged, or detained without redress should likewise receive relief and care.
idiomatic: All hundred offices should be ordered each to be diligent in his duty; all who are widowers, orphans, destitute, ill, wronged, or detained without redress should likewise receive relief and care.

literal: If there are filial sons, obedient grandsons, men of integrity and righteous conduct, talent and learning surpassing the common, or solitary conduct lofty for the age, report them fully; I shall personally review them and confer honors."
idiomatic: If there are filial sons, obedient grandsons, men of integrity and righteous conduct, talent and learning surpassing the common, or solitary conduct lofty for the age, report them fully; I shall personally review them and confer honors."

literal: Day guiwei: the deceased Prince of Fanyang Yi was posthumously restored as Prince of Qinghe.
idiomatic: On guiwei day the deceased Prince of Fanyang Yi was posthumously restored as Prince of Qinghe.

literal: Ninth month, day dingyou: the state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou day, the state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: An edict ordered Palace Attendant, Grand Commandant, and Prince of Runan Yue to enter and dwell at the Gate Below, together with Chancellor and Prince of Gaoyang Yong to decide memorials of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Yue, palace attendant, grand commandant, and prince of Runan, to enter and dwell at the Gate Below, together with Yong, chancellor and prince of Gaoyang, to decide memorials of the Masters of Writing.

literal: Eleventh month of winter, day bingshen: Prince of Zhao Commandery Mi died.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on bingshen day, Prince of Zhao Commandery Mi died.

literal: Day dingyou: Grand Mentor Cui Guang died.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Grand Mentor Cui Guang died.

literal: Twelfth month: Xiao Yan sent generals to raid the frontier; an edict made acting General Who Conquers the South Cui Yanbo commander to attack them.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xiao Yan sent generals to raid the frontier; an edict made Cui Yanbo, acting general who conquers the south, commander to attack them.

literal: Grand Commandant and Prince of Runan Yue was made Grand Mentor.
idiomatic: Yue, grand commandant and prince of Runan, was made grand mentor.

literal: Yuan Hao, inspector of Xuzhou and Prince of Beihai, was removed from office and stripped of rank for corruption.
idiomatic: Yuan Hao, inspector of Xuzhou and prince of Beihai, was removed from office and stripped of rank for corruption.

literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, day xinchou: the imperial carriage performed the suburban sacrifice at the southern altar.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on xinchou day, the imperial carriage performed the suburban sacrifice at the southern altar.

literal: Intercalary second month, day guisi: the Hephthalites sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the intercalary second month, on guisi day, the Hephthalites sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third month: the people of Woye Garrison, Po Luhan Baling, gathered a crowd and rebelled, [8] killed the garrison commander, and styled their era True King, year one.
idiomatic: In the third month the people of Woye Garrison, Po Luhan Baling, gathered a crowd and rebelled, [8] killed the garrison commander, and styled their era True King, year one.

literal: An edict made Prince of Huaiyang Yu general who guards the army and acting general who campaigns north, grand commander of all armies of the northern campaign, to attack them.
idiomatic: An edict made Yu, prince of Huaiyang, general who guards the army and acting general who campaigns north, grand commander of all armies of the northern campaign, to attack them.

literal: Fourth month of summer: the chieftain of Gaoping, Hu Chen, rebelled, styled himself King of Gaoping, and attacked garrisons in support of Baling.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the chieftain of Gaoping, Hu Chen, rebelled, styled himself King of Gaoping, and attacked garrisons in support of Baling.

literal: Separate commander Lu Zuyuan defeated them; Chen fled north.
idiomatic: Separate commander Lu Zuyuan defeated them; Chen fled north.

literal: Fifth month: Prince of Huaiyang Yu was defeated at Wuyuan and stripped of office and rank.
idiomatic: In the fifth month Yu, prince of Huaiyang, was defeated at Wuyuan and stripped of office and rank.

literal: Day renshen: an edict made Minister of the Masters of Writing Li Chong grand commander and ordered him to lead Prince of Guangyang Yuan and others on the northern campaign.
idiomatic: On renshen day an edict made Li Chong, minister of the Masters of Writing, grand commander and ordered him to lead Yuan, prince of Guangyang, and others on the northern campaign.

literal: Sixth month: the people of Qin Province, Moqi Taiqi, seized the city and rebelled, styled himself King of Qin, and killed Inspector Li Yan.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the people of Qin Province, Moqi Taiqi, seized the city and rebelled, styled himself King of Qin, and killed Inspector Li Yan.

literal: An edict ordered Inspector of Yong Province Yuan Zhi to attack them.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Yuan Zhi, inspector of Yong Province, to attack them.

literal: The people of South Qin Province, Sun Yan, [9] Zhang Changming, and Han Zuxiang seized the city and rebelled, killed Inspector Cui You, and joined Taiqi.
idiomatic: The people of South Qin Province, Sun Yan, [9] Zhang Changming, and Han Zuxiang seized the city and rebelled, killed Inspector Cui You, and joined Taiqi.

literal: Taiqi sent the townsman Bu Chao to seize Gaoping, [10] killed Garrison Commander Helian Lue and Mobile Office Director Gao Yuanrong.
idiomatic: Taiqi sent the townsman Bu Chao to seize Gaoping, [10] killed Garrison Commander Helian Lue and Mobile Office Director Gao Yuanrong.

literal: Taiqi soon died; his son Niansheng succeeded, usurped the title of Son of Heaven, styled his era Tianjian, and established the full bureaucracy.
idiomatic: Taiqi soon died; his son Niansheng succeeded, usurped the title of Son of Heaven, styled his era Tianjian, and established the full bureaucracy.

literal: Day dingyou: a general amnesty.
idiomatic: On dingyou day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jiayin: an edict made Minister of Personnel Yuan Xiuyi also Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Western Route Mobile Office commander, to lead the generals on the western campaign.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiayin day, an edict made Yuan Xiuyi, minister of personnel, also vice director of the Masters of Writing and western route mobile office commander, to lead the generals on the western campaign.

literal: Day wuwu: Prince of Hejian Chen and Prince of Huaiyang Yu had their original fiefs restored.
idiomatic: On wuwu day Chen, prince of Hejian, and Yu, prince of Huaiyang, had their original fiefs restored.

literal: Commander Cui Xuan was defeated on the White Road; Grand Commander Li Chong led the army back to Pingcheng. Because Chief Clerk Zu Ying had intercepted and seized army supplies, he was removed from office and stripped of rank.
idiomatic: Commander Cui Xuan was defeated on the White Road; Li Chong, grand commander, led the army back to Pingcheng. Because Chief Clerk Zu Ying had intercepted and seized army supplies, he was removed from office and stripped of rank.

literal: Day dingchou: Niansheng sent his commanders Yang Bonian, Fan Yuan, Zhang Lang, and others to attack the garrisons of Qiuchou and Hechi; Inspector of East Yi Province Wei Zijian sent generals Yin Xiang and Li Shuhe to defeat them, beheaded Fan Yuan, and killed more than a thousand bandits.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Niansheng sent his commanders Yang Bonian, Fan Yuan, Zhang Lang, and others to attack the garrisons of Qiuchou and Hechi; Wei Zijian, inspector of East Yi Province, sent generals Yin Xiang and Li Shuhe to defeat them, beheaded Fan Yuan, and killed more than a thousand bandits.

literal: That month: the chieftain of Liang Province, Yu Puti, and Huyan Xiong seized Inspector Song Ying and held the province in rebellion.
idiomatic: That month the chieftain of Liang Province, Yu Puti, and Huyan Xiong seized Inspector Song Ying and held the province in rebellion.

literal: Niansheng sent his elder brother, Prince of Gaoyang Tiansheng, down from Long to raid east.
idiomatic: Niansheng sent his elder brother, Prince of Gaoyang Tiansheng, down from Long to raid east.

literal: Eighth month, day jiawu: Yuan Zhi was greatly defeated east of Long and withdrew to defend Qi Province.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiawu day, Yuan Zhi was greatly defeated east of Long and withdrew to defend Qi Province.

literal: Day bingshen, an edict stated: "Rewards honor long service; a clear-sighted lord constantly shows virtue;
idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict stated: "Rewards honor long service; a clear-sighted lord constantly shows virtue;

literal: favor reaches old merit; a sage ruler keeps the constant pattern.
idiomatic: favor reaches old merit; a sage ruler keeps the constant pattern.

literal: Taizu, Emperor Daowu, answered the age, quelled disorder, and greatly founded the realm within the seas;
idiomatic: Taizu, Emperor Daowu, answered the age, quelled disorder, and greatly founded the realm within the seas;

literal: Shizu, Emperor Taiwu, succeeded the martial enterprise and spread the royal work; he personally led the Six Armies and swept away the fleeing filth;
idiomatic: Shizu, Emperor Taiwu, succeeded the martial enterprise and spread the royal work; he personally led the Six Armies and swept away the fleeing filth;

literal: the townsmen of the various provinces and garrisons had originally served as fangs and claws, toiled in campaigns, shared hardship on the march, and tasted every fatigue.
idiomatic: the townsmen of the various provinces and garrisons had originally served as fangs and claws, toiled in campaigns, shared hardship on the march, and tasted every fatigue.

literal: When Xianzu, Emperor Xianwen, moved from north to south and the Huai and sea longed for order, he then divided powerful clans to guard the frontier garrisons.
idiomatic: When Xianzu, Emperor Xianwen, moved from north to south and the Huai and sea longed for order, he then divided powerful clans to guard the frontier garrisons.

literal: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, far following Pan Geng, was about to move to Song and Luo, planned to block the northern frontier and open the southern marches, selected worthy clan chiefs, increased garrisons on the northern rim—the defense of the frontier rested on these men.
idiomatic: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, far following Pan Geng, was about to move to Song and Luo, planned to block the northern frontier and open the southern marches, selected worthy clan chiefs, increased garrisons on the northern rim—the defense of the frontier rested on these men.

literal: The late emperor, because their loyal service was already clear, was about to add further rewards, when alarms flared at Wan and Ying and at Xun and Si; battle flags moved again and again and war dragged on for years. That grace still lies dormant, down to today; the rise of resentful rebellion owes much to this.
idiomatic: The late emperor, because their loyal service was already clear, was about to add further rewards, when alarms flared at Wan and Ying and at Xun and Si; battle flags moved again and again and war dragged on for years. That grace still lies dormant, down to today; the rise of resentful rebellion owes much to this.

literal: I unworthily inherit the heavenly succession, govern the universe, adjust the winds and spread government, and think to extend broad favor—former grace should be pursued and later bounty spread.
idiomatic: I unworthily inherit the heavenly succession, govern the universe, adjust the winds and spread government, and think to extend broad favor—former grace should be pursued and later bounty spread.

literal: All garrison soldiers of the provinces who were not originally assigned as convicts are entirely freed as commoners; garrisons are changed to provinces and keep their former names.
idiomatic: All garrison soldiers of the provinces who were not originally assigned as convicts are entirely freed as commoners; garrisons are changed to provinces and keep their former names.

literal: These men for generations practiced arms and are mostly stalwart and brave; now that they are selected, they should think to repay their debt.
idiomatic: These men for generations practiced arms and are mostly stalwart and brave; now that they are selected, they should think to repay their debt.

literal: Draft three or five from each group to campaign against those bandits west of Long.
idiomatic: Draft three or five from each group to campaign against those bandits west of Long.

literal: When men join their strength and strike as vanguard, the demon hosts and mad rebels can surely be swept away.
idiomatic: When men join their strength and strike as vanguard, the demon hosts and mad rebels can surely be swept away.

literal: Charges, beheadings, and ranks will follow the standing rewards."
idiomatic: Charges, beheadings, and ranks will follow the standing rewards."

literal: Day dingyou: the herdsman Yu Qizhen of South Xiurong rebelled and killed Grand Master of Splendid Carriages Lu Yan.
idiomatic: On dingyou day the herdsman Yu Qizhen of South Xiurong rebelled and killed Lu Yan, grand master of splendid carriages.

literal: Separate commander Erzhu Rong pacified them.
idiomatic: Separate commander Erzhu Rong pacified them.

literal: Day wuxu: Moqi Niansheng sent Commander Dou Shuang to attack Pantou commandery.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Moqi Niansheng sent Commander Dou Shuang to attack Pantou commandery.

literal: Inspector of East Yi Province Wei Zijian sent General Dou Nianzu to attack them, beheaded Shuang, and captured and beheaded more than a thousand.
idiomatic: Wei Zijian, inspector of East Yi Province, sent General Dou Nianzu to attack them, beheaded Shuang, and captured and beheaded more than a thousand.

literal: Ninth month, day renshen: an edict made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Prince of Qi Xiao Baoyu grand commander of the Western Route Mobile Office and ordered him to lead General Who Campaigns West and Commander Cui Yanbo; another edict restored General Who Pacifies the Army and Prince of Beihai Yan to office and rank as commander, and both were to lead the generals on the western campaign.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen day, an edict made Baoyu, left vice director of the Masters of Writing and prince of Qi, grand commander of the western route mobile office and ordered him to lead Yanbo, general who campaigns west and commander; another edict restored Yan, general who pacifies the army and prince of Beihai, to office and rank as commander, and both were to lead the generals on the western campaign.

literal: Day yihai: the emperor visited the Bright Hall and gave a farewell feast for Baoyu and the others.
idiomatic: On yihai day the emperor visited the Bright Hall and gave a farewell feast for Baoyu and the others.

literal: That month: Xiao Yan sent generals Pei Sui and Yu Hong to seize and hold the outer wall of Shouchun; Inspector Changsun Zhi drove them off; Sui withdrew to camp at Lijiang.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Yan sent generals Pei Sui and Yu Hong to seize and hold the outer wall of Shouchun; Changsun Zhi, inspector, drove them off; Sui withdrew to camp at Lijiang.

literal: An edict ordered Prince of Hejian Chen to gather troops to reinforce them.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Chen, prince of Hejian, to gather troops to reinforce them.

literal: Yan again sent generals to raid Huaiyang; an edict ordered Secretary Supervisor and Prince of Anle Jian to lead troops to attack them.
idiomatic: Yan again sent generals to raid Huaiyang; an edict ordered Jian, secretary supervisor and prince of Anle, to lead troops to attack them.

literal: Tuyuhun ruler Fuliancou led troops to attack Liang Province; [11] Yu Puti abandoned the city and fled; he was pursued and beheaded. The townsman Zhao Tianan again installed Song Ying as inspector.
idiomatic: Tuyuhun ruler Fuliancou led troops to attack Liang Province; [11] Yu Puti abandoned the city and fled; he was pursued and beheaded. The townsman Zhao Tianan again installed Song Ying as inspector.

literal: Tenth month of winter: the people of Ying Province, Liu Anding and Jiudexing, seized the city and rebelled, seized Inspector Li Zhongzun.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the people of Ying Province, Liu Anding and Jiudexing, seized the city and rebelled and seized Li Zhongzun, inspector.

literal: The townsman Wang E'er beheaded Anding and surrendered.
idiomatic: The townsman Wang E'er beheaded Anding and surrendered.

literal: Dexing fled east and styled himself King of Yan.
idiomatic: Dexing fled east and styled himself King of Yan.

literal: Hu Chen sent his general Su Qinmingda to raid the three provinces of Bin, Xia, and North Hua.
idiomatic: Hu Chen sent his general Su Qinmingda to raid the three provinces of Bin, Xia, and North Hua.

literal: Day renwu: an edict ordered Commander and Prince of Beihai Yan to lead the generals to attack them.
idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered Yan, commander and prince of Beihai, to lead the generals to attack them.

literal: Eleventh month, day wushen: Moqi Tiansheng took Qi Province, seized Commander Yuan Zhi and Inspector Pei Fenzhi.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wushen day, Moqi Tiansheng took Qi Province, seized Yuan Zhi, commander, and Pei Fenzhi, inspector.

literal: The people of Gaoping attacked and killed Bu Chao and together welcomed Hu Chen.
idiomatic: The people of Gaoping attacked and killed Bu Chao and together welcomed Hu Chen.

literal: Twelfth month, day renchen: an edict made Grand Tutor and Prince of Jingzhao Ji grand preceptor and grand general and ordered him to lead the generals to attack them.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renchen day, an edict made Ji, grand tutor and prince of Jingzhao, grand preceptor and grand general and ordered him to lead the generals to attack them.

literal: The Hephthalites, Khitan, Didouyu, Kumo Xi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The Hephthalites, Khitan, Didouyu, Kumo Xi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: The mountain Hu of Zhengping and Pingyang in Fen Province rebelled.
idiomatic: The mountain Hu of Zhengping and Pingyang in Fen Province rebelled.

literal: An edict restored the fief and rank of General Who Campaigns East and Prince of Zhangwu Rong and made him grand commander to lead troops to attack them.
idiomatic: An edict restored the fief and rank of Rong, general who campaigns east and prince of Zhangwu, and made him grand commander to lead troops to attack them.

literal: Wei Zijian, eastern route mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, won over the Di people of South Qin, restored six commanderies and twelve garrisons, and also beheaded the bandit king Han Zuxiang.
idiomatic: Wei Zijian, eastern route mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, won over the Di people of South Qin, restored six commanderies and twelve garrisons, and also beheaded the bandit king Han Zuxiang.

literal: The bandit king of South Qin, Zhang Changming, pressed hard, then reported surrender to Xiao Baoyu.
idiomatic: The bandit king of South Qin, Zhang Changming, pressed hard, then reported surrender to Xiao Baoyu.

literal: That month: Moqi Niansheng sent troops to attack Liang Province; the townsman Zhao Tianan again seized the inspector and joined them.
idiomatic: That month Moqi Niansheng sent troops to attack Liang Province; the townsman Zhao Tianan again seized the inspector and joined them.

literal: Day guihai: Xiao Baoyu and Cui Yanbo greatly defeated the Qin bandits on the Black River, captured and beheaded tens of thousands; Tiansheng withdrew into Longxi; Jing, Qi, and all lands east of Long were pacified.
idiomatic: On guihai day Xiao Baoyu and Cui Yanbo greatly defeated the Qin bandits on the Black River, captured and beheaded tens of thousands; Tiansheng withdrew into Longxi; Jing, Qi, and all lands east of Long were pacified.

literal: Ji, grand preceptor, grand general, and Prince of Jingzhao, was made Grand Commandant; his other offices remained as before.
idiomatic: Ji, grand preceptor, grand general, and prince of Jingzhao, was made grand commandant; his other offices remained as before.

literal: Second month: Leader of the Court Guards Yuan Cha was made Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Bearer of the Triple Staff.
idiomatic: In the second month Yuan Cha, leader of the court guards, was made grand general who conquers on horseback and bearer of the triple staff.

literal: An edict posthumously restored Prince of Leliang Changming to his original rank; his son Zhong succeeded him.
idiomatic: An edict posthumously restored Prince of Leliang Changming to his original rank; his son Zhong succeeded him.

literal: Palace Attendant, Special Advance, and Grand General of the Guard Mu Shao was made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
idiomatic: Mu Shao, palace attendant, special advance, and grand general of the guard, was made bearer of the triple staff.

literal: Day wuxu: a general amnesty.
idiomatic: On wuxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Day renchen: Moqi Niansheng sent commanders Yang Zha, Liang Xiabian, Jiang Qi, and others to attack Qiuchi commandery; Wei Zijian, mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, sent General Sheng Qian to defeat them and beheaded Xiabian, Qi, and others.
idiomatic: On renchen day Moqi Niansheng sent commanders Yang Zha, Liang Xiabian, Jiang Qi, and others to attack Qiuchi commandery; Wei Zijian, mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, sent General Sheng Qian to defeat them and beheaded Xiabian, Qi, and others.

literal: Day renyin, an edict stated: "Encouraging good and removing evil is a splendid canon for governing the state.
idiomatic: On renyin day an edict stated: "Encouraging good and removing evil is a splendid canon for governing the state.

literal: Let each year's end see prefects list magistrates and inspectors list prefects and chancellors, to fix assessment grades and distinguish ability and inability.
idiomatic: Let each year's end see prefects list magistrates and inspectors list prefects and chancellors, to fix assessment grades and distinguish ability and inability.

literal: If there is abuse or error, let the assessors be judged for losing the mean."
idiomatic: If there is abuse or error, let the assessors be judged for losing the mean."

literal: That month: the people of Wei commandery in Qi Province, Fang Bohe, gathered a crowd and rebelled.
idiomatic: That month the people of Wei commandery in Qi Province, Fang Bohe, gathered a crowd and rebelled.

literal: An amnesty was proclaimed and they dispersed.
idiomatic: An amnesty was proclaimed and they dispersed.

literal: Third month, day jisi: an edict ordered Grand Commandant, Western Route Commander, and Prince of Jingzhao Ji to withdraw the army.
idiomatic: In the third month, on jisi day, an edict ordered Ji, grand commandant, western route commander, and prince of Jingzhao, to withdraw the army.

literal: Day renshen, an edict stated: "The Chancellor, Prince of Gaoyang, is deep and broad in virtue and conduct, clear and sincere in judgment, a model on the Great Steps, spreading influence to the realm below—truly one to assist where I err and bear the charge of bringing order. The new regulations should be promulgated far and near."
idiomatic: On renshen day an edict stated: "Yong, chancellor and prince of Gaoyang, is deep and broad in virtue and conduct, clear and sincere in judgment, a model on the Great Steps, spreading influence to the realm below—truly one to assist where I err and bear the charge of bringing order. The new regulations should be promulgated far and near."
